executive_summary_en: Atmospheric dispersion advisory: Plume PLUME-TN-20260819-01 centered at Uber H3 88618925d3fffff indicates elevated PM2.5 of 146.0 µg/m³ and NO2 column of 3.45e+15 mol/m². Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) dispersion modeling predicts peak concentration of 174.0 µg/m³ in 24 hours driven by wind vector (-3.4 m/s, 1.6 m/s). Primary jurisdiction elected: Chennai, Tamil Nadu (IN) under RACI allocation.

translations.PT: Parecer de dispersão atmosférica: A pluma PLUME-TN-20260819-01 no índice H3 88618925d3fffff apresenta PM2.5 de 146.0 µg/m³ e coluna de NO2 de 3.45e+15. A modelagem PINN projeta pico de concentração em 24 horas. Autoridade primária designada: Chennai, Tamil Nadu (IN).
